network_acls.description: (Optional) The network ACL configuration for the Key Vault. If not specified then the Key Vault will be created with a firewall that blocks access. Specify `null` to create the Key Vault with no firewall. - `bypass` - (Optional) Should Azure Services bypass the ACL. Possible values are `AzureServices` and `None`. Defaults to `None`. - `default_action` - (Optional) The default action when no rule matches. Possible values are `Allow` and `Deny`. Defaults to `Deny`. - `ip_rules` - (Optional) A list of IP rules in CIDR format. Defaults to `[]`. - `virtual_network_subnet_ids` - (Optional) When using with Service Endpoints, a list of subnet IDs to associate with the Key Vault. Defaults to `[]`.
